summary: required_by maps an option to one or more options that must also be set when it is specified.
questions: How do I require mode, owner and group whenever path is set?

answer_card.title: Option dependencies: required_by
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
required_by={
  'force': 'force_reason',
  'path': ('mode', 'owner', 'group'),
}
```
If the key option is given, the mapped option(s) must be given too.
